Necrozma

Psychic

Alola · Generation 7 · Legendary Pokémon

Necrozma is a Psychic-type Prism Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2.4 m tall and weighs 230 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (127), with a base stat total of 600.
